records.description_rewritten: Formsandgrube Steinbach (also described as Sandgrube Auer/Neuer Anbau) is a woodland lake near Auer in Moritzburg, outside Dresden city proper. A longstanding gay-szene forum contains several recent and conflicting firsthand posts: 22 June 2026 visitor reports a busy parking area; 18 June says nothing happening; 9 June says they visited successfully; 17 April claims many people around lake and some opportunistic meetings; August 5 question asks about couples, not confirmation. Reports are self-reported, not official authorisation, and current swimming-water quality and perimeter gates/fences need verification. The source pin and city label should reflect Moritzburg/Auer rather than central Dresden.
